name: Charge category code
description: Code specifying the category of charges.

values.name: All charges
values.description: All charges All amounts calculated by the carrier in accordance with tariffs or in case of special events during the voyage (e.g. Rail - freights costs - additional costs).

values.name: Additional charges
values.description: Additional charges Charges calculated by the carrier for specific events like re-weighting, re-loading, unexpected operations, services required during the voyage, etc.

values.name: Transport charges + additional charges
values.description: Transport charges + additional charges Transport charges plus Additional charges (e.g. for re- loading, re-weighting or unexpected operations) that must be precised in the payment conditions by the consignor (other charges must be taken in account by the consignee).

values.name: Basic freight
values.description: Basic freight The basic freight payable on the cargo as per tariff.

values.name: Destination haulage charges
values.description: Destination haulage charges Haulage charges for transporting goods to the destination.

values.name: Disbursement
values.description: Disbursement Sums paid out by ship's agent at a port and recovered from the carrier.

values.name: Destination port charges
values.description: Destination port charges Charges payable at the port of destination.

values.name: Miscellaneous charges
values.description: Miscellaneous charges Miscellaneous charges not otherwise categorized.

values.name: Transport charges up to a specified location
values.description: Transport charges up to a specified location Transport charges to be paid by a specified party for a part of a voyage, i.e. up to a specified location.

values.name: Origin port charges
values.description: Origin port charges Charges payable at the port of origin.

values.name: Origin haulage charges
values.description: Origin haulage charges Haulage charges for the pickup of goods at origin.

values.name: Other charges
values.description: Other charges Unspecified charges.

values.name: Specific amount payable
values.description: Specific amount payable Amount that the consignor agrees to be invoiced or to pay. This amount is part of the total charges applied to the consignment.

values.name: Transport costs (carriage charges)
values.description: Transport costs (carriage charges) Monetary amount calculated on the basis of the transport tariffs or contract eventually including charges or other costs.

values.name: All costs up to a specified location
values.description: All costs up to a specified location All amounts to be paid by the consignor for a part of the voyage, i.e. up to a location that must be precised. (The remaining part of the voyage to be paid by the consignee) The amounts are calculated by the carrier in accordance with tariffs or in case of special events during the voyage (e.g. rail - freight costs - additional costs).

values.name: Weight/valuation charge
values.description: Weight/valuation charge Code to indicate weight/valuation charges to be either wholly prepaid or wholly collect.

values.name: All costs
values.description: All costs All cost elements.

values.name: Supply of certificate of shipment
values.description: Supply of certificate of shipment Charges payable for the supply of a certificate of shipment.

values.name: Supply of consular formalities or certificate of origin
values.description: Supply of consular formalities or certificate of origin Charges payable for the supply of consular formalities or certificate of origin.

values.name: Supply of non-categorised documentation in paper form
values.description: Supply of non-categorised documentation in paper form Charges payable for the supply of one or more documents in paper form that are not otherwise categorised.

values.name: Supply of customs formalities, export
values.description: Supply of customs formalities, export Charges payable for the supply of export customs formalities.

values.name: Supply of customs formalities, transit
values.description: Supply of customs formalities, transit Charges payable for the supply of transit customs formalities.

values.name: Supply of customs formalities, import
values.description: Supply of customs formalities, import Charges payable for the supply of import customs formalities.
